papers.title: Three-dimensional direct laser writing inspired by stimulated-emission-depletion microscopy

Combined, circularly polarized beams
Leica HCX PL APO, NA 1.4

papers.mechanism: A central phase step in the depletion pupil produces axial and radial inhibition around the excitation volume. This is not simply a lateral doughnut.
papers.modelLimits: No stimulated depletion, vectorial PSF, triplet dynamics or resin kinetics are simulated. Combiner placement is inferred from the stated common objective, not a published mechanical drawing.
unknowns: Excitation repetition rate and pulse duration are not specified in the retrieved manuscript.
Depletion 50 mW is before the objective; ordinary excitation 7.4–8.3 mW is not a single fixed source power.
Central mask occupies 50% of the pupil area; the 2D drawing cannot encode radial area fractions.
